name: KDP Cowpens K-Cup Packaging - Cowpens SC

fieldNotes.UNRESOLVED: Could not locate a KDP K-Cup packaging facility in Cowpens, SC. The roster entry is 'dossier-named' with no street address ('Specific street address not located - flag for deep-audit'). The supplied geocode (35.016998,-81.804141) is the Cowpens town center — a small commercial downtown with no industrial facility.
fieldNotes.research: Extensive web research found NO documented KDP / Keurig K-Cup or coffee facility in Cowpens. Every KDP coffee-roasting / K-Cup-packaging operation in South Carolina is consistently attributed to the MOORE facility in Spartanburg County (6135 Anderson Mill Rd / Tyger River Industrial Park, Moore SC) — which is roster idx 1, itself described in its source note as the 'dossier-named major K-Cup hub.' SC Governor, SC Dept of Commerce, Food Manufacturing, and KDP careers all place K-Cup roasting/packaging in Moore, not Cowpens.
fieldNotes.likelyMisattribution: This entry (idx 19) appears to be a duplicate / misattribution of the Moore K-Cup hub (idx 1). Cowpens is a very small town (total manufacturing employment ~222 across all employers per Data USA) — implausible for a significant standalone KDP K-Cup packaging plant. No KDP signage or branding found on any Cowpens industrial building.
fieldNotes.cowpensIndustry: Cowpens does host industrial sites (Upstate Corporate Park / Spartanburg East Logistics Park on Mt Olive Rd; Bericap closures plant at 1300 Mt Olive Rd; a Dollar Tree SE distribution center) but none is a KDP facility.
fieldNotes.recommendation: Treat idx 19 as a roster error / unresolved. If KDP does lease undocumented packaging space inside a Cowpens warehouse, it could not be confirmed from imagery or public sources — human verification required.
fieldNotes.geofence: perimeter is a nominal placeholder box around the Cowpens town-center geocode; it does NOT represent an identified facility. yardMetrics are zeroed and all classification fields are uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Cowpens is a small rural town in upstate SC — Rural — but this is moot given the facility is unresolved.

citations.claim: KDP operates an active K-Cup roasting/packaging complex in Spartanburg County SC (~285 employees), still hiring.
Active KDP Spartanburg warehouse/distribution reqs confirm the SC operation is live in 2026.

verification.rationale: KDP K-Cup packaging in Spartanburg County is confirmed live, but no Tier-1 source names a Cowpens facility specifically; the documented KDP coffee complex is in Moore (~20mi SW). The Cowpens pin is likely a mis-geocode of the Spartanburg complex - exact Cowpens address unverified.
